personality_one_liner: Extremely simple, high-contrast premium golf utility optimized for bright sunlight and glanceability outdoors.

spacing.rule: Generous padding and huge touch targets (min 60pt) are critical for outdoor sunlight usage. Do not cramp elements.

dont's: Avoid glassmorphism completely; outdoor sunlight readability requires flat, high-contrast solid surfaces.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Land the user at the closest course and get them into the round with one massive tap.

states.loading: Centered spinner while fetching GPS location.
states.error: GPS error message with 'Search Courses' retry button.

screens.layout: Hero image (hero_landscape) at the top with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Overlaid on the bottom 30% of the image: 'Closest Course' label and huge course title in Space Grotesk. Below the image, use a solid white surface. Place a massive, pill-shaped brandPrimary (Blue) 'START ROUND' button pinned near the bottom. A subtle 'Change Course' button sits directly underneath the primary CTA.

screens.name: CourseSelector
screens.purpose: Searchable list of golf courses sorted by distance.

states.empty: No courses match the search query.

screens.layout: Sticky search bar at the top. Full-width list rows. Each row shows a course logo (or initials), Course Name, and Distance in metres. Minimal divider between rows. Tapping a row navigates back to Home with the selected course.

screens.name: RoundScreen
screens.purpose: Core utility screen for fast score entry on the current hole.
screens.layout: Header shows 'Hole 1 / 18'. Below it, large numbers for Distance (metres) and Par/Stroke Index. The center is dominated by two massive stepper controls for 'Score' and 'Putts'. The stepper +/- buttons must be at least 60x60pt for easy outdoor tapping. Current score is displayed in a massive Space Grotesk font (3xl or larger) between the +/-. Pinned at the very bottom: a split layout with 'Previous' and 'Next Hole' buttons (Next Hole uses brandPrimary blue, Previous uses a muted surfaceSecondary). On hole 18, 'Next Hole' becomes 'Finish Round'.

screens.name: RoundSummary
screens.layout: Sticky top header summarizing 'Total Score' and 'Total Putts' in huge, bold Space Grotesk numerals. Below, a clean, high-contrast scrollable table listing all 18 holes. Each row shows Hole #, Par, Score, and Putts. Highlight birdies/bogeys with subtle brandTertiary (green) or surfaceSecondary chips if possible. Pinned bottom CTA: 'Save & Exit'.

hero_landscape.alt: Golf course landscape surrounded by trees at dawn

tee_marker.alt: Red golf tee yardage sign on the grass

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize extreme high contrast. The app is used outdoors in bright sunlight. Avoid glassmorphism, thin lines, and low-contrast grey text.
Implement huge touch targets (minimum 60x60pt) for the Score and Putts stepper buttons (+ and -) so they can be tapped easily without looking closely.
Use 'Space Grotesk' for all large numbers and metrics to ensure glanceability.
The RoundScreen must not require the keyboard. Rely entirely on the massive +/- stepper controls for data entry.
Respect the requested palette: Pure white background, dark green accents/headers, light grey cards for data grouping, and blue for primary action buttons (START ROUND, Next Hole).
Keep navigation to a simple Stack layout. Do not use bottom tabs. The user is either setting up a round or actively playing one.
Make sure distances are displayed in Metres ('m') as requested by the user.
